page.layout: Top: page number at upper left and running head across the top. Below: two circular portrait medallions side by side, each with legend text around its rim. Below them: one full-width paragraph of running text (Franciscus), then a second full-width paragraph (Carolus). No marginal notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: FRANCISCVS FILIVS · DEL.D.B. (legends of the left medallion)
CAROLVS · ANGOI DVX (legends of the right medallion)
FRANCISCVS Francisci Regis filius primogenitus,
natus anno D. 1517. Franciæ Delphinas indole verè regia, &
præsumptis à natura virtutis omnis heroïcæ egregiis principiis,
artium (quæ liberalem Principem decent) præcipuè verò milita-
ris disciplinæ studiosissimus, spē de se dedit mirabilē. Sed dum
contra hostilia Cæsaris arma Massiliam versus, expeditionem
parat, Lugduni obiter confidens, veneno necatus est à Sebastia-
no quodam Montis Cuculli Comite, qui comprachensus, vene-
ficiúmque non diffessus, neque sceleris conscios, pœnas luit, in
quatuor partes membratim helciariis equis distractus. Hic Prin-
ceps ad hunc modum veneno intus cruciante malè affectus,
ardore tamen adeundi ad Provincialia bella patris, vix Turno-
nem perlatus, magno omnium mœrore expirauit, anno suæ
ætatis 20. mense Augusti, 1536. Vide Chron. Franc. & Pau-
lum Iouium.
CAROLVS Aureliæ Dux, Regalium liberorū ex Fran-
cisco Franc.Rege natu minimus, adolescens fuit perhumanus,
liberalis, & magnanimus, præbito iam de se heroïcæ magnani-
mitatis exemplo, in expugnatione Iuodij, oppressione Arluni,
Viretonij, ac Luxemburgi, omniúmque locorum, castrorum, &
arcium circū circa inuasione, munimento, confirmatione, præ-
sidio, & commeatu, anno 1542. Bellicosissimus hic Regis filius,
in florentissimo dilectæ iuuentutis decore, acutissima febri pr-
operè extinctus est anno 1545. Vide vt supra.

page.notes: The two medallion legends are printed inside the circles; they are given above in reading order as best as the engraving allows, and are doubtful in their exact letter forms (e.g. "FRANCISCVS FILIVS", "DEL.D.B.", "ANGOI DVX", "CAROLVS"). The long s in "studiofissimus" (printed ff) and "Massiliam" (printed Maffiliam) is transcribed as plain s/ss. "comprachensus" is as printed and may be a misprint for comprehensus. The page number reads 258 in the old-style figures. Medallions are engravings and are not transcribed as text.
